```{r}
# load necessary libraries
library(sensitivity)
library(tidyverse)
library(deSolve)
library(lhs)
library(here)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in Lotka Voltera Model with the hunting parameter.
```{r}
source(here("R/lotvmodK_hunt.R"))
lotvmodK_hunt
```
Run the function with ODE function. 
```{r}
# initial conditions
currpop <- c(prey = 1000, pred = 50)

# time points to see results
days <- seq(from = 1, to = 1000, by = 1)


# set parameters
pars <- c(rprey = 0.5, 
          alpha = 0.3, 
          eff = 0.2, 
          pmort = 0.2, 
          K = 100, 
          pred_thresh = 50, 
          hunt = 0.1)

# run the model
res <- ode(func = lotvmodK_hunt, 
           y = currpop, 
           times = days, 
           parms = pars,
           method = "euler")
```
